request.subject: UNIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Redraw him as a heavy armoured swordsman with no shield at all: full polished steel plate with two big round pauldrons, a short crimson tabard with the gold cross, plate legs; a heavier steel helmet with cheek guards, gold band and tall crimson plume; one huge two-handed greatsword with a gold crossguard held upright in both hands. Keep face, proportions, feet, black outline and style the same, transparent background. Sun at the bottom left: left sides lit, right sides in shadow.
